sentences.text: No: for an existing floating-rate term loan sanctioned before 2025-12-31 to an individual for a non-business purpose, a UCB shall not charge pre-payment charges, and this case matches that rule.
The loan agreement documents conflict on the charge amount, stating 2% of principal outstanding in one version and 3% in another, but that conflict does not change the no-charge rule.
The bank's home-loan charge table also lists a pre-payment charge on pre-payment or foreclosure, but the applicable UCB rule prohibits charging it in this case.
